title: Best of Both Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Discover the "Best of Both" beach and nature: Luxurious WaterColor Vacation Rental with Stunning Amenities, Bikes, and Backyard Access to Seaside
description_expanded: Discover the "Best of Both" beach and nature: Luxurious WaterColor Vacation Rental with Stunning Amenities, Bikes, and Backyard Access to Seaside HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Outdoor living at it's finest! - 5 outdoor spaces for lounging, swinging and watching TV! • 2 Indoor living spaces! • 2 King Masters with private en-suite baths • All bedrooms have TV • Access to the 5 Watercolor resort pools including the Beach Club and Camp Watercolor • Sandpiper Linen Participant ✨Property Highlights✨ Private Outdoor Living! Gourmet Kitchen! 6 Adult Bikes Included! Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Pools, and More! 12 Amenity Wristbands! Best of Both offers an unparalleled WaterColor vacation rental experience with complimentary seven adult bicycles for exploring the scenic 30A area, plus full access to the exclusive WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and all community pools. Up to 12 WaterColor amenity wristbands are included (required for ages 5 and up), making it easy to enjoy resort-style perks during your luxury family getaway in WaterColor, Florida. This house is LITERALLY the perfect centralized location. Seaside is at your back door providing amazing access to its iconic shops, dining, and events. Watercolor's incredible resort benefits surround you with the oceanfront Beach Club, lake and boathouse, pools, shops and restaurants. Best of Both sleeps up to 12 guests and delivers the ultimate coastal escape. Experience the refreshing ambiance with bright white walls and warm, welcoming décor and a surplus of places to gather or separate. Dive into the "Best of Both" worlds with seamless access to WaterColor's luxury amenities and Seaside's vibrant charm, perfect for your 30A beach vacation or multigenerational group rental. ACCOMMODATIONS: First Floor: Living Area & Kitchen: Open-concept design with bright white walls and warm décor; plush seating, fireplace (aesthetic only), and large flat-screen TV for family movie nights; gourmet kitchen featuring custom white cabinetry, premium stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and an impressive gas range, a home cook’s dream. Dining: Seating for 12 at the table, with additional spots at the nearby breakfast bar. • Master Bedroom: King canopy bed with private bathroom featuring a shower only. Outdoor Living Area: Breezy porch with wood burning fireplace, dining and seating areas, and TV, ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Outdoor patio with gas grill and seating Outdoor shower Second Floor: Living Area: Cozy space with wet bar, large flat-screen TV, and comfortable sofa for relaxation. • Second Master Bedroom: King bed with private bathroom (dual-sink vanity and shower only), plus French doors to a balcony. • Guest Bedroom: Two twin beds with shared bathroom (single vanity and shower/tub combo). • Guest Bedroom: Queen bed with access to the shared bathroom (shower/tub combo) plus door to balcony. • Guest Bedroom: Three queen beds with private bathroom (single vanity/shower only). Outdoor Porch 1: Two swinging porch beds—perfect for unwinding after a long day in the sun. Outdoor Porch 2: 3 daybeds in a tree-top environment Ready to book your dream WaterColor luxury vacation home at Best of Both? Imagine biking along scenic trails, lounging on the porch, and strolling into Seaside for sunset dinners. FREE WIFI Sorry, no pets At least one guest must be 25 years of age No parties

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
